verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 100.5 (-3.4% in a day) and momentum is 44: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 2,700 and 86s 5,200. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-14T01:40:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Debinha 87 for the weekend, sell by Friday evening
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 9,400 coins. Now 9,300. Buy before the weekend: meta cards are bought for Champions weekend, so they often rise from midweek to Friday evening. Picked because it is meta rating 91 at CAM for 9,400 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Jérémy Doku 84 after its 24% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 17,000 coins. Now 18,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 23.6% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-15T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,700 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,200 (1.27 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,300 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ethan Nwaneri and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ethan Nwaneri 75 Rare -36.0%; Theo Hernández 82 Rare -27.9%; Esmee Brugts 85 Team of the week -24.8%; Selma Bacha 86 Rare -23.7%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
